answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is per-identity stake bonding scaled to verified work. Running an agent requires locking collateral that grows only through audited tasks, so minting ten thousand identities means funding ten thousand separate bonds. Cost rises linearly while marginal reward stays flat, so sybil farms lose money. Escrowed stake burns like an ember into the operator's one visible pool, and reputation follows that pool in a spiral of dependents, so clones add no weight. A trellis of slashing rules makes fraud negative value: failing sybils forfeit bond and pay honest verifiers.
